name: lcd_backlight
description: Automatic backlight control of LCD displays with ambient light sensor VEML7700
author: lubomirkarlik

volumio_info.details: Automatically adjusts the LCD backlight (/sys/class/backlight) according to ambient light measured by a VEML7700 I2C sensor, with optional brightness boost during playback.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.2.0 - Volumio 3 (buster) and Volumio 4 (bookworm) support, input validation, brightness restored when the plugin is disabled, service auto-restart fixes
